summary: Steven Spielberg-created World War II and modern military shooter series from EA, spanning PlayStation originals, PC Allied Assault expansions, console campaigns, modern reboots, and a VR entry by Respawn.

primary.why: The first Medal of Honor is PlayStation-only; DuckStation upscaling is the cleanest preservation route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PlayStation release in DuckStation at high internal resolution or on original hardware.

primary.why: Underground released first on PlayStation; the Game Boy Advance version is a later handheld adaptation.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PlayStation release in DuckStation; sample GBA only for handheld-version preservation.

secondary.why: It is a distinct reduced version.

entries.title: Medal of Honor: Allied Assault
entries.definitive_edition: Allied Assault War Chest / complete PC route

emulation.notes: Native Windows route with compatibility fixes.

primary.version: Allied Assault War Chest / PC release
primary.why: The PC War Chest-style route bundles Allied Assault with its two expansions and is the most complete high-fidelity path.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Windows with compatibility/widescreen fixes; install Spearhead and Breakthrough after the base campaign.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official remaster; preserve expansion patch state.

entries.title: Medal of Honor: Allied Assault Spearhead

primary.why: Spearhead is the first Allied Assault expansion and is best played on Windows with the base game.
primary.how_to_play: Install Spearhead after Allied Assault on Windows.

entries.title: Medal of Honor: Frontline

emulation.notes: Use PS3 hardware or verified RPCS3 compatibility.

primary.version: HD remaster bundled with Medal of Honor (2010)
primary.why: Frontline received an HD remaster on PlayStation 3, making it the highest-fidelity official route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS3 HD remaster; use PS2/GameCube/Xbox only for original-release comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Bundled with the PS3 version of Medal of Honor (2010).

entries.title: Medal of Honor: Allied Assault Breakthrough

primary.why: Breakthrough is the second Allied Assault expansion and is best played on Windows with the base game.
primary.how_to_play: Install Breakthrough after Allied Assault on Windows.

entries.title: Medal of Honor: Rising Sun

emulation.notes: Use Xbox emulation or original hardware.

primary.why: Rising Sun is console-only, and Xbox is the highest-fidelity sixth-generation route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Xbox hardware or xemu; use PS2/GameCube only for comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster; planned sequel was canceled.

primary.why: Infiltrator is a GBA-only entry, making mGBA the best preservation route.
primary.how_to_play: Play in mGBA or on original GBA hardware.

entries.title: Medal of Honor: Pacific Assault
entries.definitive_edition: Pacific Assault Director's Edition on Windows

primary.why: Pacific Assault is PC-focused, and the Director's Edition route is the most complete package.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Director's Edition with compatibility/widescreen fixes.

entries.remaster_caveats: Included in the 10th Anniversary Bundle on PC.

emulation.notes: Use Xbox emulation or original hardware.

primary.why: European Assault is console-only, and Xbox is the best fidelity route among its platforms.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Xbox hardware or xemu; use PS2/GameCube only for comparison.

primary.why: Heroes is PSP-only, and PPSSPP gives the best fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PSP release in PPSSPP at high internal resolution.

primary.why: Vanguard released on PS2 and Wii; Dolphin upscaling makes Wii the higher-fidelity practical route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Wii version in Dolphin at high internal resolution; use PS2 only for comparison.

primary.why: Airborne is best on Windows for fidelity and was included in the PC 10th Anniversary Bundle.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with compatibility fixes; use PS3/Xbox 360 only for comparison.

primary.why: Heroes 2 released on Wii and PSP; Dolphin-upscaled Wii is the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Wii version in Dolphin; use PSP for portable comparison.

entries.title: Medal of Honor
entries.definitive_edition: Windows release plus PS3 Frontline HD secondary if needed

primary.why: The 2010 reboot is highest-fidelity on Windows; PS3 additionally bundles the Frontline HD remaster, tracked separately under Frontline.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with current patches; play Frontline HD separately on PS3 if desired.

secondary.exclusive_content: Bundled Medal of Honor: Frontline HD remaster.
secondary.what_to_play: Play Frontline HD from the PS3 version if not otherwise archived.
secondary.why: The bundled remaster is exclusive to the PS3 package.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern reboot; do not conflate with the 1999 original.

primary.why: Warfighter is highest-fidelity on Windows and is the most configurable route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with patches; note online-service state separately.

entries.title: Medal of Honor: Above and Beyond

emulation.notes: Native VR route with supported headset.

primary.why: Above and Beyond is a VR title; PC VR through Windows/SteamVR or Rift is the highest-fidelity route, while Quest 2 is a standalone convenience route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC VR release on a supported headset; use Quest 2 standalone only for portable VR comparison.

secondary.exclusive_content: Standalone VR version with untethered play.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample only for standalone VR preservation.
secondary.why: It trades fidelity for standalone access.

entries.remaster_caveats: VR-only entry; includes the Oscar-winning documentary short Colette in its gallery mode.
